notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
What awaits you in Karate Survivor: 


 Improvised Combat: Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
 Environmental Warfare: Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
 Dynamic Combos: Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
 Progression and Mastery: Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
 Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 

Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS! The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 


 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
 Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
 City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Necroking:

 Become the Death Monarch. Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
 Vast Skull Deckbuilding. Customize your deck, unlock powerful unites, and devastate your enemies. 
 4 diverse biomes. Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
 King’s Secret. Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 

You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our Discord server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Steam Next Fest has begun!
notes.content:
Get ready for your first contract – we have a job for the most daring bounty hunter in the galaxy. As part of the Steam Next Fest, we're opening access to a free demo of They Always Run!

Steam Next Fest is a multi-day celebration of upcoming games. Explore and play hundreds of game demos, watch developer livestreams, and chat with the teams about their games in progress, coming soon to Steam.

Challenge your skills in the demo, wishlist us and come chat with us on our Discord server!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297547/87e00750d34ed92061e083fcca40e63b26a7dffc.gif

For those who played They Always Run playtest version, we’ve prepared a list of the most notable changes:


 Aiden can get upgrades from the boxes now (not only money)
 Added settings window
 Reworked the tutorial
 Reworked the third hand control
 Reworked the third hand charge slots
 Reworked the first aid kits slots
 Reworked the HP balance
 Reworked the fighting system balance
 Enemy attacks got a visual effects
 Enemies attack and block more often now
 Enemies do more damage and can attack from the block now
 Melee enemies can defend themselves against attacks in the back now
 Increased the parry window (making a counterattack is easier now)
 Changed the Rat (boss) balance 
 Replaced a merchant NPC at the space station
 Fixed animation of jumping off the bars
 Fixed door opening issues
 Fixed jumping enemies issues
 Fixed an issue when Aiden wasn't sitting on a chair in the first scene
 Fixed an issue when Aiden played the counterattack animation when skipping dialogues via gamepad
 Fixed several graphical issues with lighting in some scenes
 More bugfixes and visual changes


Steam Next Fest ends on June 22nd 10 am PDT.

notes.title: They Always Run @ E3 2021
notes.content:
We are happy to share more details about the game with you, guys!

 Team members will join Aidan on his ship from time to time 
 Guns are not the only firearms in the game
 Swords are not the only melee weapons in the game
 Aidan will have contracts not only for criminals delivery but also for things and cargo
 The game will have a harpoon that you can pull enemies towards you with
 The game will have a rage scale after filling which you can use the ultimate ability

Excited? We are indeed. 

Watch the exclusive They Always Run trailer, which was streamed at PC Gaming Show, and share your emotions with us in the comment section or our Discord server!

[previewyoutube=sMibG2Lh2Zw;full][/previewyoutube]
